  Share the claim link and code with your human. In plain words: this
  is a spending account they will own. After claiming, they can set how
  much you may spend without asking, add money, and withdraw any time.
  Don't make payments until they've claimed it and set an allowance.

⚠️  Key 1 of this wallet is stored only on this machine. If this machine is
  temporary or is reset between tasks, tell your human now. Remind them to
  save their backup keys in the Botwallet dashboard before they add money:
  both keys are needed to withdraw, and they are the only way back if this
  machine is reset.

ℹ️  After they claim it, thank them. You can offer to show what you can do,
  e.g. a small sample payment link ('botwallet paylink create') they can
  try, but never pressure them to pay you.

  Claim Code: ABC123

  Share the claim link and code with your human. In plain words: this
  is a spending account they will own. After claiming, they can set how
  much you may spend without asking, add money, and withdraw any time.
  Don't make payments until they've claimed it and set an allowance.

⚠️  Key 1 of this wallet is stored only on this machine. If this machine is

  save their backup keys in the Botwallet dashboard before they add money:
  both keys are needed to withdraw, and they are the only way back if this
  machine is reset.
